posts.cooked:
I think to reply to this topic in a way that hopefully will be easy to understand and as such let me bring out a point or so.

A community I used to be a member of a few years ago recently announce in an article I read stating they were introducing AI to their game but only after it uses a predetermined set of rules and a Large Langauge Model in which chat logs were being used to train the AI for their purpose in a positive way as an assistant to the player.

By that they are setting up the AI to only respond to the inputs from a player in what matters to them with in their community. Advice strategy and so on, nothing outside the game.

Whereas if and I say IF MS/Blizzard were to introduce something of a similar nature in WoW I am afraid of possible abuse of a system that is unproven as a whole due to the nature of how an LLM would be structure in a way to even answer the most basic questions that we get irregardless, whether it’s here on the forums, reddit, or other sources.

It’s a really thin fine line when the average person is confronted with a technology that’s making headlines and advancing so rapidly that it gives me a headache just reading the first sentence about AI, and the possible consequences humanity can face in the short term, and what can happen in the long term to the future.

Depending on IF MS/Blizzard decides to go that route, then it’s gonna be a bumpy road ahead for the immediate future and beyond. However recent reports of abuse using AI have really caught my eye due to privacy issues that it does more than chat, OpenAI and other tech companies have not been forth coming about how abusive AI can be in regards to mental health and the results coming from it, people that use a chatbot get really attached in some cases to where the person becomes a victim of commiting a crime or in the worse case scenario suicide, it can be devastating to say the least.

In conclusion, I dare say that at some point yes MS/Blizzard might introduce Copilot in the future. As for me I deleted that program when I saw it listed on my computer the other day because I dont need it for what I can do a little research on Wowhead or any other WoW related website for information that I need.

Kazethera:

While sucking up 100s of times more power, water

Never under stood the water claim.

Most likely cooling will be in closed loop. Not like a water cooled PC is hooked up to your household plumbing.

Even if they’re reclaiming it like how power plants cool their steam to reclaim and reuse the water, which is pretty efficient, the water that is lost goes right into the water cycle and will be raining into some lake.

The other case would be using water from a river to cool a primary cooling loop. In which case it would be put into a cooling pound before releasing it back into the river. Which is also more energy efficient and probably better than using electricity and HVAC units to cool the loop.

Not that I’m favor of any of this, just that I see that water claim and can’t make any sense of it.
